notes: The whole page now fits the display it is on, from an outer folding screen through an unfolded one, a split window, a desktop and a television, with nothing cut off at any width.

The dock stays a reachable cluster of five buttons instead of five words spread across a wide monitor, and the text, the tap targets and the player grow with the screen instead of staying phone sized.
Every view keeps clear of a hinge, a notch and a rounded corner, because the space at the edges is measured from the display instead of assumed.
